findings.location: 正文：各段引号内的圣经引文及引文短语
findings.source_quote: “Doth not nature itself teach you?”; “Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?” (Job 6:5); “Is any merry? Let him sing psalms” (James 5:13); “And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God” (Ps 40:3); “I will sing”; and the other quoted Scripture passages throughout the article.
findings.suggested_fix: 将正文中所有引号内的圣经引文和实质性引文短语译成简体中文，忠实保留原文含义，并保留每处原有的书卷、章节、节数、范围及引用位置。
findings.translation_quote: “Doth not nature itself teach you?”; “Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?” (Job 6:5); “Is any merry? Let him sing psalms” (James 5:13); “And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God” (Ps 40:3); “I will sing”；以及全文其余未译的引号内经文。

findings.source_quote: “...the song sparrow and again by the rose-breasted grosbeak.”
findings.suggested_fix: 将“歌雀”改为“歌雀（song sparrow）”或其合适的中文鸟名；将“玫胸秋沙鸟”改为玫胸的大嘴雀类名称（如“玫胸巨嘴雀”），不要译成秋沙鸭类。
findings.translation_quote: “歌雀（song sparrow）与玫胸秋沙鸟（rose-breasted grosbeak）的歌声”

findings.source_quote: “the major song of modern women bears chords that are but dissident and melancholy.”
findings.suggested_fix: 将“异端与忧郁”改为表达“不和谐、忧郁”之意的措辞，例如“现代许多妇女的主旋律却只奏出不和谐而忧郁的音调”。
findings.translation_quote: “现代许多妇女的主旋律却偏为异端与忧郁。”
